content:
anna: small personal update  two tiny things: accepted a Staff Engineer role today 389 and also were expecting a baby in November 476! wanted to share since youre my people.
felix: WOOO congrats both times over!! Staff Engineer 389 + baby 476 = legend status. party pls.
jamie: YESSSS congrats anna!! we need a celebration — cake? donuts? both? :party_popper:
zoe: I volunteer to organize a small office get-together. low-key, BYO baby advice.
chris: Major congrats. If you want a day off buffer around the due date, ping me and well sort on-call coverage.
riley: Also Ive got a hand-me-down Nuna stroller in great shape if you want to try it, happy to drop off.
people-ops-bot: Congrats Anna! :tada: People Ops can schedule a 30-minute "Anna: Promo + Baby" meet in the commons. React with :handshake: if you'd like People Ops to coordinate snacks & a card.
anna: thanks yall (and people-ops)  3pm Friday works for me. small things only, and no pressure on gifts.
felix: poll: Cake / Cupcakes / Donuts / Savory pastry? React with emoji.
jamie: :cupcake:
zoe: :doughnut:
chris: :cake: but honestly i will eat anything
riley: :pretzel: (savory pastry)
people-ops-bot: Reminder: follow Redwood gift policy. React with :handshake: to have People Ops manage a team gift.
zoe: :handshake:
felix: :thumbsup:
anna: you folks are the best. im so excited (and a little terrified) but mostly thrilled. thanks for the love <3
